actions.name: play
actions.description: Play one of the routines (change_routines) on the screen a step at a time for someone ("start Maya's morning routine"): each step fills the screen with its picture and they tap Done. Leave routine out for the one on now. Ticking a step with change_routines moves it on too. Say what it answers.

actions.name: stop
actions.description: Close the routine playing on the screen (chores__play).
